mapper.sql: a.tid, a.fid, a.title, a.url, a.type_name AS typeName, a.is_sticky AS isSticky, a.is_digest AS isDigest, a.is_locked AS isLocked, a.has_attachment AS hasAttachment, a.has_image AS hasImage, a.price, a.author_uid AS authorUid, a.author_name AS authorName, a.author_url AS authorUrl, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.reply_count AS replyCount, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.last_reply_uid AS lastReplyUid, a.last_reply_name AS lastReplyName, a.last_reply_at AS lastReplyAt, a.rating, a.page_index AS pageIndex, a.raw_row_html AS rawRowHtml, a.first_seen_at AS firstSeenAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt

where.if: AND (a.title LIKE #{search} OR a.author_name LIKE #{search} OR a.last_reply_name LIKE #{search})

mapper.select: SELECT a.type_name AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `aish123` a GROUP BY a.type_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, a.type_name ASC
